name: Optimizing Streaming Speech Recognition on Arm® Edge Devices with ExecuTorch
title: Optimizing Streaming Speech Recognition on Arm® Edge Devices with ExecuTorch
headline: ExecuTorch streaming speech recognition gets faster on Arm
lede: Developers can run streaming speech recognition on Arm edge devices with ExecuTorch, which PyTorch says runs up to 2.12x faster on Pixel 11.

effects.effect: on-device voice input gets closer to real time
edge apps can stream speech without cloud calls

possibilities.title: People with variable speech can test a phone-based conversation repair aid
possibilities.connection: ExecuTorch supplies streaming speech recognition on Arm devices, and ZONOS3-Mini supplies phone-based speech generation with voice cloning and word-level control.

works_with.title: ZONOS3-Mini clones voices on phones
via: People with variable speech can test a phone-based conversation repair aid
